description: Route and prioritise a support ticket
rules: Anything mentioning a chargeback, refund or invoice goes to billing, even if it also describes a bug.
Data loss or a security concern is always fully blocking.

team.instructions: Which team should own this ticket?

criteria.billing: invoices, refunds, chargebacks, payment methods, plan changes
criteria.tech: bugs, errors, outages, performance, integrations, API
criteria.account: login, password, profile, permissions, team members
criteria.sales: pricing questions before purchase, demos, enterprise contracts

urgent.instructions: Does this ticket need a response within the hour?

blocked.instructions: How much is the customer blocked from using the product?
criteria: not blocked, a question or request
